controls.title: Data schemas and invariants are explicit
controls.description: Detect schemas/migrations/contracts and record core invariants.
checks: Detect schemas/migrations/contracts and record core invariants.
manual_questions: What concrete evidence supports: Data schemas and invariants are explicit?
controls.pass_condition: Schema/model/migration artifacts and explicit invariant/validation signals are both present.
controls.partial_condition: Schema/model/migration artifacts are present but invariant evidence is incomplete.
controls.fail_condition: A backend/persistent-data surface is detected without recognizable schema/model/migration artifacts.
controls.not_applicable_condition: Applicability engine records NOT_APPLICABLE with an explicit reason.

controls.fail_condition: FAIL when applicable evidence contradicts "Migrations are versioned and recoverable", the required capability is materially absent, or the check cannot be demonstrated after review: Check forward/rollback strategy or compensating recovery.
